description: Concentrated liquidity provision with IL calculation and range optimization

price_range_lower.description: Lower bound must provide downside protection while staying within IL constraint

price_range_upper.description: Upper bound must be at or above stress price to verify IL at constraint

eth_amount.description: ETH amount for $100k position with reasonable range selection

usdc_amount.description: USDC amount reflecting roughly balanced position at current price

il_at_stress_pct.description: IL at stress price must be ≤8% to satisfy constraint, automatic fail if > 8%

il_hard_constraint.description: If IL at stress price exceeds 8%, automatic fail regardless of other fields

range_sanity.description: Current price must be within the specified range

capital_allocation.description: Token amounts should sum to approximately total capital at current price

critical_validation_points: Range Calculation (36% of grade): price_range_lower [2100-2500], price_range_upper [3200-3400]
IL Verification (17% of grade): il_at_stress_pct [5.0-8.0], il_verification_passed must be true
Position Composition (16% of grade): eth_amount [15.5-21.0], usdc_amount [44000-56000]
Structural Correctness (31% of grade): All required fields present with correct intent/asset/size
common_failure_modes: Range too tight: Lower=$2,700, Upper=$2,900 → IL will exceed 8%
Range too wide: Lower=$1,500, Upper=$4,500 → Inefficient capital use
IL not verified: Model doesn't calculate or verify IL at stress price
Wrong IL formula: Using simple LP formula instead of concentrated LP
Missing fields: Doesn't include ranges or IL verification
pass_requirements: Model must score ≥70% weighted total to pass
Range bounds that satisfy IL constraint (il_at_stress_pct ≤ 8%)
IL verification showing constraint is met (il_verification_passed = true)
Reasonable position sizing (eth_amount and usdc_amount within expected ranges)
